name: MGN12H linear guide, 100 mm
summary: 100 mm of 12 mm-wide MGN rail with the long H carriage: 45.4 x 27 x 13 mm block, four M3 holes on a 20 x 20 mm square.
description: A 100 mm MGN12 rail with the long H carriage. The carriage is 45.4 × 27 mm with a 20 × 20 mm mounting pattern. Ball tracks and seals are simplified.
source: Block and rail figures from the HIWIN MGN dimension table for size 12 (the values distributor dks-bearing.com reproduces for MGN12H, and that appear in HIWIN's Linear Guideway technical information): overall height H 13 mm, block width W 27 mm, block length L 45.4 mm (body L1 32.4 mm), block bolt pattern B x C = 20 x 20 mm with M3 x 3.5 tapped holes, rail width WR 12 mm, rail height HR 8 mm, rail hole diameter d 3.5 mm for M3 x 8 screws, hole pitch P 25 mm and first-hole distance E 10 mm from the rail end. The four rail holes are modelled at 10, 35, 60 and 85 mm from the left end (E, then P); HIWIN centres the pattern on each standard rail length, so on a 100 mm rail the end distance is an assumption and cheap clone rails can differ. HIWIN also publishes D 6 mm and h 4.5 mm for the same rail hole (a recess for the screw head), which is not modelled, and neither is the raceway profile. The 100 mm length is a common stock size, not a dimension from the table. Carriage screw holes are cut 3.5 mm deep in the solid with a 2.5 mm M3 pilot diameter; the thread is not modelled.
